items.text: Publishing path (GitHub remote with `npx github:jblossey/houserules`, or npm). Trigger: the owner's ruling on docs/design.md §5.3. Prerequisite HR-001; the `files` whitelist is done.

Adoption path for tag-pilot. Trigger: the first houserules release or publish (raise with decision 3; re-deferred 2026-09-01 after PR #42 merged). Until then tag-pilot stays the upstream of the kit-owned files; diff tools/, .claude/agents/, .claude/skills/ against template/ before every release and port the drift.
A Claude Code plugin as a complement for the static agent templates and the orchestrating skill (docs/design.md §3). Trigger: a second adopter that wants central updates.
